record_title: Universal asymptotic attractor for tie-free largest-dihedral-angle bisection
provenance: Analytic asymptotic consequences of the invariant largest-dihedral-angle bisection recurrence proved by Korotov and Michaud in arXiv:2609.18788.
limitations: The theorem concerns only the retained branch in the specific invariant two-parameter family with c=7/8. It does not classify arbitrary LAB seeds, sibling branches, global conformity closure, or alternative refinement rules. The initial-condition-dependent prefactor C is characterized by a convergent product rather than a closed form. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; contemporaneous or not-yet-indexed follow-up to the recent source remains a residual risk.
